name: What materials are common for front doors and which is best?

mainEntity.name: What materials are common for front doors and which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common front door materials include steel, fiberglass, and wood. Steel doors are known for their security and durability, often being the most budget-friendly. Fiberglass doors offer excellent energy efficiency, resist dents, and can mimic the look of wood without the maintenance. Wood doors provide a classic, natural aesthetic but require more upkeep and can be more susceptible to weathering. The 'best' material depends on your priorities regarding budget, maintenance, aesthetics, and energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular front door materials are steel (secure, durable, affordable), fiberglass (energy-efficient, low maintenance), and wood (classic look, higher maintenance). The best choice depends on your specific needs.
